newsitem.title: UK: BASS TO EXPAND HOLIDAY INN EXPRESS IN UK.
newsitem.headline: BASS TO EXPAND HOLIDAY INN EXPRESS IN UK.

text.p: Bass Taverns, a division of brewer to leisure group Bass Plc, said it will open 20 Holiday Inn Express hotels in Britain by the end of 1998 through a franchise agreement with its sister company Holiday Inn Worldwide.
All 20 hotels will be managed by Bass Taverns, which plans to invest over 30 million stg and create around 300 jobs.
There are currently five Holiday Express hotels in Britain: the first opened in Leeds last year and the next will be at Glenrothes in Fife, Scotland.
All will be newly built hotels next to existing Bass owned food and drink outlets. The company said it plans to open about 70 Holiday Inn Express hotels in Britain by 2002.
